definition: to get free suddenly and run
description: At a rural cattle show on an overcast day, a shaggy ginger Highland cow with long curved horns charges towards the camera across the grass, its lead rope flying loose in the air. A young woman with braids in a white show coat reaches after it, and more handlers in white coats stand behind. The cow swerves and gallops along a wooden fence lined with spectators, who lean back as it passes. Other Highland cattle stand in a line, and a tipped bucket and a brush lie on the grass.

taps.phrase: to reach for the loose rope
